rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records for the entire import is within threshold.
Checks that all active StatVars (1935 in input0, 227 in input1) have MaxDate >= 2023-11.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_svs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN MaxDate >= '2023-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_svs FROM stats
params.condition: (total_svs >= 1935 AND active_svs >= 1935) OR (total_svs BETWEEN 227 AND 300 AND active_svs >= 227)

rules.description: Checks that no StatVar regresses below the oldest historical wave (2013-07).

params.condition: MaxDate IS NOT NULL AND MaxDate >= '2013-07'
